CREATE TABLE schedules ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, student_group_id BIGINT NOT NULL, course_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
lesson_start TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, lesson_end TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT fk_schedules_group FOREIGN KEY (student_group_id) REFERENCES groups (id),
CONSTRAINT fk_schedules_course FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses (id) );
